DQF File Check | Audit

Per the regulation — in the DQF required files is the following. Review each section carefully.

Pre-Employment Window — All time-sensitive docs must be within 30 days before hire date
Updated — May 2026
1

🪪CDL Front SideREQUIRED

CDL front side must be current, with no damages, cuts, holes, or "void" words.

2

🪪CDL Back SideREQUIRED

CDL back side must be current, with no damages, cuts, holes, or "void" words. Must include all Restrictions and Endorsements as on the front side.

Make sure all restrictions listed on the back and front side are NOT prohibiting the driver from interstate commerce.

🚫 Prohibited Restrictions — must be fixed:
  • K restriction — Intrastate commerce only: driver is prohibited from driving across states ❗
  • L restriction — No Air Brake: driver is prohibited from driving most semi trucks ❗
  • O restriction — No semi-tractor trailer CMV: driver prohibited from driving in combination ❗
  • Since regulations in each state are updated regularly, some restrictions may change — for consult please refer to a manager
3

🏥Medical CardREQUIRED

The only accepted format is the federal form MCSA-5876 shown below. Any other format must be rejected and the correct form requested.

Standard medical cards are issued for 2 years. If issued for less than 2 years, it is not required but preferred to have the full medical card report. Page 4 shows the exact reason for shorter issuance.

✅ Verify the following on the Medical Card:
  1. Reviewed medical card belongs to the reviewed driver
  2. Medical card is not expired
  3. Medical card is issued for 2 years
  4. Issued to the current Driver license number (if not — request listed CDL from the driver)
4

🔎National Registry FMCSA for the DoctorREQUIRED

All doctors issuing medical cards are required to have DOT Certification. On file must be proof of verification from the FMCSA National Registry of Certified Medical Examiners (NRCME).

✅ Verify:
  1. National registry number on file = National registry number on the NRCME
  2. Issue date on the medical card CANNOT BE after the certification date on the NRCME
5

🚗MVR — Motor Vehicle RecordREQUIRED

MVR is Motor Vehicle Record — history of driving.

First MVR is pre-employment and cannot be more than 30 days before hiring, and must be ordered BEFORE hire date. (You cannot let the driver drive under your company without checking their driving history.)

All MVR services are different across states and provide different information. Examples:

  • FL State provides all data of previously issued CDL/DL; IL only provides dates with no note whether it was CDL or DL
  • GA State does not show issue date of the medical card, only expiration date
  • NJ and TX states do not show issue date of the CDL, only expiration date
  • UT State shows issue date of the first medical card and expiration date of the last medical card assigned
  • LA State doesn't share medical card information at all
✅ All MVRs must show:
  1. Order date
  2. License number on which MVR has been ordered
  3. Name of the person on which MVR has been ordered
  4. Current address of the person
  5. Date of Birth
  6. State of the license
  7. Violations on this license number
  8. Suspensions on this license
  9. Current license info: Class, Issue date, Expiration date, Restrictions, Endorsements, Status
  10. Medical card information and status

The CDL and Medical card on file MUST EQUAL information on the MVR.

✅ CDL Status — Accepted
  • VALID
  • LICENSED
  • VALID CLEAR
✅ Medical Card Status — Accepted
  • NON-EXCEPTED INTERSTATE
🚫 CDL Status — NO GO
  • Suspended
  • Cancelled
  • Not Licensed
  • Expired
  • Surrendered
🚫 Medical Card Status — NO GO
  • Non Excepted intrAstate
  • Excepted Intrastate
  • Excepted Interstate
💡 Per regulation — drivers are prohibited from having more than 1 active CDL. We're required to run MVR for all CDLs issued in the last 3 years, and all except the current one must be either Surrendered or Expired.
6

📄PSP ReportNOT REQUIRED

PSP is History of DOT Inspections of the driver.

PSP is not required by regulation, but strongly preferred — it shows the driver's commercial vehicle history for the past 5 years (past 3 years of inspections and last 5 years of DOT recordable accidents).

PSP can be requested only with First and Last name — no middle name. Even one mistype in name, CDL number, or date of birth may cause an empty PSP result.

7

🔍ClearingHouse QueryREQUIRED

ClearingHouse is a secure online database managed by FMCSA. It tracks drug and alcohol violations for CDL holders. Employers must use it for pre-employment and annual queries.

First ClearingHouse query is pre-employment and cannot be more than 30 days before hiring, and must be requested BEFORE hire date.

✅ Verify the following on ClearingHouse Query:
  1. Provided ClearingHouse is for the reviewed driver
  2. ClearingHouse conducted from the company to which driver is being hired
  3. Query completed not later than 30 days before date of hiring, and not after date of hiring
  4. Query type is Pre-Employment or Full
  5. Status is Provided
  6. Query Result: Driver not prohibited
  7. No open or closed violations listed — if any exist, immediately let the manager know
8

🧪Drug Test ResultsREQUIRED

Drivers are required to take a DOT Pre-Employment Drug Test.

Drug Test results must be verified by the MRO not more than 30 days before hiring, and must be verified BEFORE hire date.

✅ Drug Test Results must show:
  1. Reviewed Drug Test results are for the reviewed driver
  2. Drug Test results issued under the company to which driver is being hired, or to the collection site. If another carrier is listed — let the manager know
  3. Reason for Test: Pre-Employment
  4. Regulation / Authority: FMCSA and DOT
  5. Drug Test result: Negative or Negative-Dilute (both count as Negative)
  6. Verification date cannot be more than 30 days before hiring, and must be BEFORE hire date
❗ If items 3–5 are not as listed above — let the manager know immediately.
9

📋CCF — Custody and Control FormREQUIRED

A CCF (Custody and Control Form) is the essential document used to order a drug test and track the handling of a specimen from the donor to the lab.

CCF form is issued to a driver once the Drug Test has been taken at the collection site. Most CCF forms share the standard format shown below.

On file you're required to have a CCF Form matching the Drug Test results. To confirm they match, verify:

✅ CCF vs Drug Test must match:
  1. ID Number = Specimen ID number
  2. Same employer listed on both forms
  3. Donor name (driver) is the same on both forms
  4. Date of test is the same on both forms
💡 The date of the test on CCF cannot be more than 30 days before hiring, and must be verified BEFORE hire date.
10

📝ApplicationREQUIRED

Application is a DOT-required Formal Employment Application, which must be signed by the driver, and must be completed not more than 30 days before hiring, and before exact hire date.

All applications vary, but the required sections are:

  • Company to which the Application is being filled
  • Driver Information: Name, Social Security number, Date of Birth, Current Residential address
  • License history for last 3 years: License numbers, Issuing states, Expiration dates
  • Driving record: Any revocations/suspensions/denials, all violations from past 3 years, all accidents from past 3 years
  • Employment history: All employers for last 3 years (name, date, position) with no gaps greater than 30 days. If driver held CDL for more than 3 years — past 10 years of employment required
✅ How to check the Application:
  1. Company is listed correctly (driver is employed by VS Carriers INC dba Vista Trans)
  2. Name is listed correctly
  3. Address on application matches CDL
  4. CDL number, State, Class, Expiration date matches CDL
  5. Last employment covers the month of application or previous months (no gaps greater than 30 days)
  6. If driver listed position as truck driver — check section 8
  7. We're required to contact previous employers, so driver needs to place "yes"
  8. If section 6 lists "truck driver", section 8 must say "Yes"
  9. If section 8 says "Yes", section 9 must also say "Yes" to both questions
💡 If you have a PSP with inspections — use it for Employment history. Each inspection and/or accident listed on PSP is clear proof of employment at a company.

As shown above — no gaps more than 30 days were found.

💡 For your convenience — try to visualize employment history as a chronological line so the whole line is filled with no gaps.

No violations are listed in MVR and PSP — nothing required to be listed in the Driving History section.

11

📅Annual MVRANNUAL

If the driver has been hired for more than 365 days, a new MVR must be run and compared with all current information on file — CDL, Medical card, and status of the Medical card.

12

📅Annual ClearingHouseANNUAL

If the driver has been hired for more than 365 days, a Limited ClearingHouse query must be performed.
